thread:
sarah: Hey @runtime, quick blocker on docs PR #482 — I added a migration snippet for model routing that says 'fallback -> hosted auto-variant' when dedicated capacity is unavailable. CI preview passed but runtime behavior might be different. Can someone confirm actual behavior?
kevin: tagging — we need the exact config snippet. quick answer: runtime prefers in-deployment compatible variants, not automatically switching to hosted unless explicitly configured.
sarah: snippet below 

```
routes:
  - name: critical-path
    model: model-x:v2
    fallback: true
    fallback_policy: auto
```

sarah: The PR language currently: "If dedicated capacity is exhausted, requests fall back to a hosted auto-variant." Is that wrong?
tina: putting merge on hold until we have runtime confirmation + a tiny code example in SDK snippet. cc: @kevin for wording.
kevin: short answer: wrong as-written. More precise: "If a route has fallback enabled, the router will attempt compatible in-deployment variants or region-tier fallbacks. Automatic fallback to hosted public variants only happens for hosted API customers and when the customer's routing policy allows external fallbacks."
sarah: ok that is clearer. Can you suggest a 1-line replacement we can use in the docs?
kevin: "When fallback is enabled, the router will prefer compatible variants within the same deployment; fallback to the hosted API or cross-deployment variants occurs only if the customer's routing policy explicitly permits external fallbacks."
jonathan: adding nuance — also call out the default for Dedicated/Private: external fallbacks are off by default for tenancy/isolation reasons. So docs should say default behavior differs by deployment mode.
sarah: great, we'll update PR to include that sentence + a short SDK example showing how to opt into external fallbacks.
kevin: one more edge: quantized variants may be considered compatible only if sequence length and KV cache behavior match. Might be worth a parenthetical.
sarah: yep will add: "(compatibility checks include model architecture, sequence length profile, and KV cache/quantization compatibility)."
tina: CI preview link? I couldn't view the runtime tests in the preview.
ci-bot: preview deployed for PR #482 — https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/pr/482 (status: success) :white_check_mark:
sarah: thanks. @docs-bot please add label "merge-on-runtime-confirmation" so reviewers know it's blocked.
docs-bot: label "merge-on-runtime-confirmation" added by docs-bot.
tina: Ok, once the wording change is pushed and kevin+jonathan ack, I'll approve and merge during the midday merge window. Please ping here when pushed.
sarah: pushed wording + SDK opt-in snippet. PTAL.
kevin: acked — wording SGTM, + noted quantization parenthetical.
jonathan: ack from platform side. You can proceed with merge after my +1 in the PR.
tina: merging now, thanks all. :tada:
